test_title: PYST 15: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Indian naval platforms took part in the Indo-Oman naval exercise Naseem-Al-Bahr held in October 2024?

options.text: INS Trikand and Dornier Maritime Patrol Aircraft
INS Kolkata and Sea Guardian drone
INS Vikrant and MiG-29K fighter jets

solution:
The correct answer is __**INS Trikand and Dornier Maritime Patrol Aircraft**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indo-Oman naval exercise **Naseem-Al-Bahr**, meaning “Sea Breeze,” is a biennial event conducted between the Indian Navy and the Royal Navy of Oman to strengthen maritime cooperation.
 
• **INS Trikand** is a Talwar-class frigate of the Indian Navy, equipped with advanced weapons and sensors, capable of conducting anti-submarine, anti-surface, and air defense operations.
 
• The **Dornier Maritime Patrol Aircraft** is a short-range aircraft used by the Indian Navy for reconnaissance, surveillance, and intelligence gathering missions. *Hence, this platform participated in the exercise.*
 
• Other platforms mentioned in the options, such as **INS Kolkata**, **Sea Guardian drone**, **INS Shivalik**, **P-8I aircraft**, and **INS Vikrant**, did not participate in the **Naseem-Al-Bahr** exercise for October 2024. These platforms are used for different operational requirements and exercises. *Hence, these options are incorrect.*
 
• The exercise in October 2024 focused on improving interoperability, joint operations, and mutual understanding between the two navies. *Hence, the correct answer is INS Trikand and Dornier Maritime Patrol Aircraft.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **INS Trikand:**

 
 
• **Commissioned:** INS Trikand was commissioned in **2013**. It is a stealth frigate capable of engaging multiple threats in air, surface, and underwater domains.
 
• **Features:** Equipped with **BrahMos missiles**, advanced radar systems, and anti-submarine warfare capabilities.
 
• **Applications:** Used for maritime security, escort missions, and joint exercises.
 
 
 
• **Dornier Maritime Patrol Aircraft:**
 
 
• **Purpose:** Designed for **surveillance and reconnaissance missions** over coastal areas.
 
• **Features:** Equipped with advanced radar systems and cameras for real-time intelligence gathering.
 
• **Applications:** Widely used by the Indian Navy for **monitoring exclusive economic zones (EEZs)** and search-and-rescue operations.
 
 
 
• **Indo-Oman Relations:**
 
 
• **Historical Ties:** India and Oman share a long history of **maritime and trade relations**, dating back centuries.
 
• **Strategic Partnership:** Oman is a key partner in India’s maritime security framework in the **Indian Ocean Region (IOR)**.
 
• **Joint Exercises:** Naseem-Al-Bahr focuses on promoting mutual cooperation and understanding between the navies of both countries.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Features of Naseem-Al-Bahr:**

 
 
• This bilateral exercise emphasizes **anti-piracy operations**, search-and-rescue missions, and maritime domain awareness.
 
• It strengthens the capability of the two navies to operate together and ensures maritime safety in the region.
 
• The exercise also includes **cross-deck operations**, communication drills, and tactical maneuvers.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Maritime Exercises:**
 
 
• They enhance mutual understanding, interoperability, and coordination between navies.
 
• They serve as a platform to exchange operational knowledge and technical expertise.
 
• Such exercises are crucial in safeguarding maritime trade routes and enhancing regional security.
